title: Memory and justice
goal: I can describe how Argentina and Chile faced the past, contrasting the imperfect and the present perfect.

items: I can say how things were before and how they have changed, with the imperfect and the present perfect.
I can say what happened at the trial of the juntas in 1985.
I can explain what the laws of 1986 and 1987 did and what changed in 2003.
I can name the commissions that investigated the crimes.
I can use the new words for trials, justice and memory.
